usage: qualify.py [-h] [--jdk JDK] [--patch PATCH]
                  [--artifact-receipt ARTIFACT_RECEIPT] [--work-dir WORK_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --jdk JDK
  --patch PATCH
  --artifact-receipt ARTIFACT_RECEIPT
                        Fresh build_candidates.py ARTIFACTS.json with exact
                        sealed compiler source pins; omission requires the
                        historical exact patch pin
  --work-dir WORK_DIR   New, nonexistent isolated directory; default creates a
                        unique /tmp directory
